tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Every frame background and the base of lower thirds. NNB black, never pure black #000000. White on ground is 17.2:1.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Plates and cards sitting on ground: lower-third plates, spec cards, stat boxes. White on panel is 15.5:1. Only 1.1:1 against ground, so it never reads as a shape alone: give it a pillar-coloured edge, bar or dot.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines, dividers and empty progress tracks. 1.4:1 against ground, so it never carries meaning on its own and is never text.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Ground at 80%, behind text laid over B-roll when a solid plate feels heavy. The contrast ratios in this system assume solid ground, so over bright footage check by eye and switch to panel if in doubt.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, panel and scrim. Also a card fill when a stat needs to jump, with ground-coloured text on it (17.2:1).

tokens.name: white-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: sources, units, the second line of a lower third. 5.2:1 on ground, 5.0:1 on panel. 40px and up, because video compression softens thin grey type.

tokens.name: nest
tokens.usage: Nest green, the Nest pillar (home and smart tech): the single accent for any Nest video. 5.1:1 on ground, so fine as text at any on-screen size. Text on a nest fill is ground (5.1:1); white on nest is 3.4:1, so 64px and up only.

tokens.name: nomad
tokens.usage: Nomad yellow, the Nomad pillar (outdoor and adventure): the single accent for any Nomad video. The strongest of the three on dark at 7.9:1. Text on a nomad fill is always ground (7.9:1). Never white on nomad (2.2:1).

tokens.name: beyond
tokens.usage: Beyond pink, the Beyond pillar (portable tech): the single accent for any Beyond video. 4.4:1 on ground, just under the 4.5:1 bar, so as text use it at 48px and up (lower-third size and larger), never for support lines. Text on a beyond fill: ground at 48px and up (4.4:1), white at 64px and up (3.9:1).

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Chapter and title cards. One line, five words or fewer.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Six hours in a cold van

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Key numbers and single-line points. The floor for anything a viewer has to read on a phone in portrait.

styles.name: lower-third
styles.usage: Lower-third main line: product, place or person.

styles.name: support
styles.sample: Tested at Lake Garda in August
styles.usage: Lower-third second line, spec labels, units.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: We may earn a small commission if you buy through our links
styles.usage: Non-essential text only: sources and on-screen affiliate notes. Never the only place a point is made.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Gap between a dot and its label. Disc size of the three-dot mark at lower-third scale.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Padding inside plates and cards. Gap between lines in a text block.

tokens.name: safe-x
tokens.usage: Left and right margin at 1920x1080 (5% action-safe). No text outside it.

tokens.name: clear-bottom
tokens.usage: Keep essential text above the bottom 150px of the frame. YouTube's controls, progress bar and our captions sit there.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills. The three dots are circles, so in SVG draw them as circle elements rather than using rx.
